sources.title: Speaker Encoder | hamptus/mlx-swift-qwen3-tts | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The Speaker Encoder weights often come from frameworks (like PyTorch) where Conv1d weights are stored as [out_channels, in_channels, kernel_width]. MLX uses a different convention.

sources.title: GitHub - appautomaton/mlx-speech: Pure-MLX speech synthesis, voice ...
sources.snippet: Note: The mlx-speech CLI covers the common generation, voice cloning, editing, waveform streaming, and transcription paths. For advanced controls (sampling temperature, top-p/k, diffusion steps, batch JSONL, duration tuning, etc.) use the family-specific scripts in scripts/ where provided. Each model guide in docs/ names its canonical advanced entry point and supported controls.
